text:
The evidence does not establish that the property was deforested. Hansen data detected **67.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2020**, but tree-cover loss alone does not prove conversion of forest to another land use.

The 2020 loss occurred before the tool’s 31 December 2020 baseline, so it is outside the assessed claim interval. The JRC reference mapped no forest on the property in 2020. After the baseline, the only reported loss was 0.4 ha in 2021, in patches below the tool’s 0.5 ha event threshold.
